frontmatter_snapshot.summary: MBS holders are effectively short a prepayment option: when rates fall, borrowers refinance and principal arrives early to be reinvested at lower rates (contraction risk); when rates rise, prepayments slow and effective maturity extends (extension risk). The PSA convention parameterises the CPR ramp; pass-through and CMO tranches reshape the prepayment exposure asymmetrically.
